app_map.app: Sundal - multi-tenant Laravel + Inertia/React SaaS project management platform
app_map.tenancy: Workspace is the tenant boundary (not User). BelongsToWorkspace trait scopes queries to auth()->user()->current_workspace_id via a global scope.
permission_systems: Spatie laravel-permission (route middleware + RoleSeeder.php, source of truth)
App\Traits\HasPermissionChecks (used by ~33 controllers) - checkPermission() gives BLANKET ACCESS to any user with type==='company', bypassing Spatie entirely
app_map.seeded_test_accounts: superadmin@test.com / company@test.com / manager@test.com / member@test.com / client@test.com, password123, share 'Test Workspace' (id=4)

nav_structure.superadmin: separate nav tree: Dashboard, Companies, Media Library, Plans(+Requests+Orders), Coupons, Landing Page(+Custom Pages+Contact Inquiries+Newsletter), Settings
nav_structure.owner/manager/member/client: 13 shared top-level items via buildCommonNavItems(): Dashboard, Workspaces, Team, Projects(All Projects/Tasks/Bugs), Calendar, Timesheets(My/Weekly/Approvals), Contracts, Chat, Meetings(Zoom/Google), Finance(Invoices/Budgets/Expenses/ExpenseApprovals/Taxes), Docs(KB/Notes), Forms, AI, Reports(Project/Timesheet), Billing(owner only), Settings

known_module_gating_differences.manager: no Workspaces/Billing nav; has Team, Calendar (module list includes 'calendar','task_calendar'), Timesheet Approvals, Contracts(view/create/edit not delete), Taxes(view/create/edit not delete)
known_module_gating_differences.member: no Workspaces/Billing/Settings; Tasks full CRUD incl delete; Budgets view-only own-projects; Expenses own full CRUD; KB view+attachments only
known_module_gating_differences.client: most restrictive: no Team/Timesheets/Chat/Docs/Forms/AI/Settings; no standalone Tasks page (task_view_any absent) but CAN change task status via Calendar (task_change_status permission); Contracts view/preview/sign(accept-decline)/comment; Invoices view-only; no Budget/Expense access at all

app_map.unified_shell_routes: finance, reports, meetings, docs use server-side redirectToFirstPermittedTab pattern in routes/web.php to avoid Inertia page-flash
app_map.superadmin_workspace_block: BlockSuperAdminWorkspaceAccess middleware (alias block.superadmin.workspace) abort_if(user.type==='superadmin', 403) is applied to a large workspace-scoped route group. dashboard route explicitly opts out via withoutMiddleware. Superadmin is meant to reach real workspace/company data only via an Impersonate flow.
app_map.test_data_present: Workspace has 33 projects (owner view) / 14-17 (member/manager view, scoped), multiple PW-TEST prefixed projects/tasks/bugs/contracts/invoices/expenses/timesheets from prior automated test runs, 3 contracts, 5 invoices, ~10 companies (superadmin view).
